challenges.powerbi: Smooth from Excel; migrating from Tableau/Qlik means DAX retraining and rebuilding visuals.
challenges.tableau: Easy for analysts coming from Excel; enterprise governance takes longer without an expert in place.
challenges.looker: Biggest upfront lift — requires building a LookML model from scratch, but pays off long-term.
challenges.thoughtspot: Needs a clean, modelled warehouse first; if data isn’t warehouse-ready, that becomes the real project.
challenges.qlik: QlikView-to-Sense needs app conversion; the associative model has a learning curve for new users.
challenges.sigma: Fastest migration for spreadsheet-heavy teams; limited value if the org isn’t warehouse-centric yet.
